title: Adi-khanda, part 2 (portion 10)
html:
Balya-lila (continued): the first rice-feeding and the name Vishvambhara; the first steps; Shachi's lullaby; at night the gods enthrone the child, and He dances with them singing of Radha and Krishna; the sound of ankle-bells on bare feet; pranks and broken pots; a rite for the boy's welfare; the Lord sits among discarded pots and teaches His mother about pure and impure

এক দুই তিন চারি পাঁচ ছয় মাসে ।
নামকরণ হইল অন্নপ্রাশন-দিবসে ॥ ১০৩ ॥

eka dui tina cāri pāṁca chaẏa māse |
nāmakaraṇa haila annaprāśana-dibase || 103 ||

eka dui tina chari pancha chhaya mase — in one, two, three, four, five, six months; namakarana haila — the naming took place; annaprashana-divase — on the day of the first rice-feeding

103One, two, three, four, five, six months [passed] —
and on the day of the first rice-feeding the naming was performed.

পুত্র-মহোৎসব করে মিশ্র পুরন্দর ।
অলঙ্কারে ভূষিত সোণার কলেবর ॥ ১০৪ ॥

putra-mahotsaba kare miśra purandara |
alaṅkāre bhūṣita soṇāra kalebara || 104 ||

putra-mahotsava kare — holds a great festival for the son; mishra purandara — Mishra Purandara; alankare bhushita — adorned with ornaments; sonara kalevara — the golden body

104Mishra Purandara celebrates a festival for his son;
the golden body [of the child] is decked with ornaments:

অঙ্গদ কঙ্কণ করে গলে মতিহার ।
কটি স্বর্ণ-শিকলি মগরা পায়ে আর ॥ ১০৫ ॥

aṅgada kaṅkaṇa kare gale matihāra |
kaṭi sbarṇa-śikali magarā pāẏe āra || 105 ||

angada kankana kare — armlets and bracelets on the arms; gale matihara — a pearl necklace on the neck; kati svarna-shikali — a golden chain at the waist; magara paye ara — and anklets on the feet

105armlets and bracelets on His arms, a pearl necklace on His neck,
a golden chain around His waist, and anklets on His feet.

মাড়িল হিঙ্গুল যেন কর-পদতলে ।
অধর বান্ধুলি আঁখি রাতা উতপলে ॥ ১০৬ ॥

māṛila hiṅgula yena kara-padatale |
adhara bāndhuli āṁkhi rātā utapale || 106 ||

madila hingula yena — as if vermilion were rubbed; kara-pada-tale — on palms and soles; adhara bandhuli — the lips a bandhuli flower; ankhi rata utapale — the eyes red lotuses

106His palms and soles look as if rubbed with vermilion,
His lips are a bandhuli flower, His eyes red lotuses.

বিজুরী মাজিল গোরা-অঙ্গে ঠাঁই ঠাঁই ।
ঝলমল অঙ্গতেজ চাহিতে না পাই ॥ ১০৭ ॥

bijurī mājila gorā-aṅge ṭhāṁi ṭhāṁi |
jhalamala aṅgateja cāhite nā pāi || 107 ||

bijuri majila — lightning is rubbed; gora-ange — on Gora's limbs; thain thain — here and there; jhalamala anga-teja — the body's radiance glitters; chahite na pai — one cannot look

107It is as if lightning had been rubbed onto Gora's limbs here and there:
His body glitters so that one cannot look at it.

বিশ্বপালনে থুইল বিশ্বম্ভর নাম ।
সরস্বতী-সংবাদ এ পুরুষপ্রধান ॥ ১০৮ ॥

biśbapālane thuila biśbambhara nāma |
sarasbatī-saṃbāda e puruṣapradhāna || 108 ||

vishva-palane — for sustaining the world; thuila vishvambhara nama — the name Vishvambhara was given; sarasvati-samvada — the message of Sarasvati; e purusha-pradhana — this is the Supreme Person

108Because He sustains the world, He was given the name Vishvambhara1:
such was the message of Sarasvati — this is the Supreme Person.

ক্ষণে পিতা-মাতা-কর-অঙ্গুলি ধরিয়া ।
অথির শরীর পড়ে পদ দুই যাঞা ॥ ১০৯ ॥

kṣaṇe pitā-mātā-kara-aṅguli dhariẏā |
athira śarīra paṛe pada dui yāñā || 109 ||

kshane — now; pita-mata-kara-anguli dhariya — holding the fingers of father and mother; athira sharira — unsteady in body; pade — falls; pada dui yana — after going two steps

109Now, holding the fingers of father and mother,
He takes two steps and falls, unsteady on His feet.

অব্যকত আধ আধ লহু লহু বোলে ।
চান্দের সায়রে যেন অমিয়া উথলে ॥ ১১০ ॥

abyakata ādha ādha lahu lahu bole |
cāndera sāẏare yena amiẏā uthale || 110 ||

abyakata — indistinctly; adha adha — by halves; lahu lahu bole — speaks softly, softly; chandera sayare — in the ocean of the moon; yena amiya uthale — as if nectar wells up

110Indistinctly, by halves, softly, softly He babbles —
as if nectar were welling up in an ocean of moonlight.

এইমতে দিনে দিনে আঙ্গিনা বেড়ায় ।
ঘুচিল বিবিধ তাপ জগত জুড়ায় ॥ ১১১ ॥

eimate dine dine āṅginā beṛāẏa |
ghucila bibidha tāpa jagata juṛāẏa || 111 ||

ei-mate dine dine — thus day by day; angina bedaya — wanders about the courtyard; ghuchila vividha tapa — sufferings of all kinds vanished; jagata judaya — the world is cooled

111So day by day He toddles about the courtyard;
sufferings of every kind are gone, the world is cooled.

লখিমী-লালিত পদ ধরণীর কোলে ।
প্রেমায় পৃথিবী দেবী আপনা পাসরে ॥ ১১২ ॥

lakhimī-lālita pada dharaṇīra kole |
premāẏa pṛthibī debī āpanā pāsare || 112 ||

lakhimi-lalita pada — the feet caressed by Lakshmi; dharanira kole — on the lap of the earth; premaya — from love; prithivi devi — the goddess Prithivi; apana pasare — forgets herself

112The feet that Lakshmi caresses are on the lap of the earth:
from love the goddess Prithivi forgets herself.

গগনে একলা চান্দ ভূমে দশ চান্দ ।
কিরণের তেজে যে যে আঁখি পাইল আন্ধ ॥ ১১৩ ॥

gagane ekalā cānda bhūme daśa cānda |
kiraṇera teje ye ye āṁkhi pāila āndha || 113 ||

gagane ekala chanda — in the sky a single moon; bhume dasha chanda — on the ground ten moons; kiranera teje — by the brilliance of the rays; ye ye ankhi — whatever eyes [look]; paila andha — were blinded

113In the sky there is one moon, but on the ground ten moons2:
the brilliance of their rays blinds the eyes of those who look.

আর দশ চান্দ কর-অঙ্গুলির আগে ।
পাতকী দেখিয়া হিয়া-আন্ধিয়ার ভাগে ॥ ১১৪ ॥

āra daśa cānda kara-aṅgulira āge |
pātakī dekhiẏā hiẏā-āndhiẏāra bhāge || 114 ||

ara dasha chanda — ten more moons; kara-angulira age — at the tips of the fingers; pataki dekhiya — a sinner seeing; hiya-andhiyara bhage — the darkness of the heart flees

114And ten more moons are at the tips of His fingers:
if a sinner but looks, the darkness flees from his heart.

শ্রীমুখ-চান্দ কত কোটি চান্দের রাজা ।
ভুরু-কামধনু দিয়া কাম কৈল পূজা ॥ ১১৫ ॥

śrīmukha-cānda kata koṭi cāndera rājā |
bhuru-kāmadhanu diẏā kāma kaila pūjā || 115 ||

shrimukha-chanda — the moon of the beautiful face; kata koti chandera raja — king of many millions of moons; bhuru-kama-dhanu diya — offering the brows, Kama's bow; kama kaila puja — Kama worshipped

115The moon of His beautiful face is king of many millions of moons;
His brows are Kama's bow: Kama worshipped [Him] by offering his bow.

কি কহিব আর তার করুণা-চন্দ্রিমা ।
অন্তরে তিমির কাটে নাহি করে ক্ষমা ॥ ১১৬ ॥

ki kahiba āra tāra karuṇā-candrimā |
antare timira kāṭe nāhi kare kṣamā || 116 ||

ki kahiba ara — what more shall I say; tara karuna-chandrima — of the moonlight of His mercy; antare timira kate — cuts the darkness within; nahi kare kshama — shows no mercy [to it]

116What more can I say of the moonlight of His mercy?
It cuts through the darkness in the heart and does not spare it.3

কে কহিতে পারে তার বালক-চরিত্র ।
লৌকিক আচারে কৈল পৃথিবী পবিত্র ॥ ১১৭ ॥

ke kahite pāre tāra bālaka-caritra |
laukika ācāre kaila pṛthibī pabitra || 117 ||

ke kahite pare — who can tell; tara balaka-charitra — His childhood deeds; laukika achare — by ordinary conduct; kaila prithivi pavitra — made the earth holy

117Who can tell of His childhood pastimes?
Behaving like an ordinary child, He sanctified the earth.

অগ্রজ তাহার বিশ্বরূপ মহাশয় ।
অল্পকালে সর্বশাস্ত্র জানে গুণময় ॥ ১১৮ ॥

agraja tāhāra biśbarūpa mahāśaẏa |
alpakāle sarbaśāstra jāne guṇamaẏa || 118 ||

agraja tahara — His elder brother; vishvarupa mahashaya — the worthy Vishvarupa; alpa-kale — in a short time; sarva-shastra jane — knows all the scriptures; gunamaya — full of virtues

118His elder brother is the worthy Vishvarupa:
endowed with every virtue, in a short time he mastered all the scriptures.

তাঁহার মহিমা-তত্ত্ব কে কহিতে পারে ।
যাহার অনুজ মহাপ্রভু বিশ্বম্ভরে ॥ ১১৯ ॥

tāṁhāra mahimā-tattba ke kahite pāre |
yāhāra anuja mahāprabhu biśbambhare || 119 ||

tanhara mahima-tattva — the truth of his greatness; ke kahite pare — who can tell; yahara anuja — whose younger brother; mahaprabhu vishvambhare — is Mahaprabhu Vishvambhara

119Who can tell the truth of his greatness —
of him whose younger brother is Mahaprabhu Vishvambhara?

দিনে দিনে করে প্রভু করুণা প্রকাশ ।
শুনি আনন্দিত হিয়া এ লোচনদাস ॥ ১২০ ॥

dine dine kare prabhu karuṇā prakāśa |
śuni ānandita hiẏā e locanadāsa || 120 ||

dine dine — day by day; kare prabhu karuna prakasha — the Lord manifests mercy; shuni — hearing; anandita hiya — the heart rejoices; e lochanadasa — of this Lochana Dasa

120Day by day the Lord reveals His mercy;
hearing of it, the heart of this Lochana Dasa rejoices.

Raga varadi

*Moon, moon, moon up in the sky —
who will pluck it and bring it to me?
Wiping off its stain,
I will paint a design on my Gora's forehead.
Come, come, come! My golden little son Nimai
is crying — He wants to sleep;
when He is fretful, every little word of His
is sweeter than nectar.*

এখনি আসিবে, নিমাইর বাপ,
ক্ষীর-কদলক লঞা ।
হের আসিছে বাপু, হাউ দুরন্ত রে,
নিন্দ যাহ আঁখি মুদিয়া ॥ ১২১ ॥

ekhani āsibe, nimāira bāpa,
kṣīra-kadalaka lañā |
hera āsiche bāpu, hāu duranta re,
ninda yāha āṁkhi mudiẏā || 121 ||

ekhani asibe — will come now; nimaira bapa — Nimai's father; kshira-kadalaka lana — bringing thickened milk and bananas; hera asichhe bapu — look, child, is coming; hau duranta re — the dreadful bogey; ninda yaha — go to sleep; ankhi mudiya — closing the eyes

121"Nimai's father will come right now,
bringing thickened milk and bananas.
Look, little one, here comes the dreadful bogey4 —
close Your eyes and go to sleep!"

সোণার পদ্ম মুখ, রাতা-পদ্ম আঁখি,
মুদিত আধটি তারা ।
হেন বুঝি পারা, মধুর পাথারে,
ডুবিল আধ ভ্রমরা ॥ ১২২ ॥

soṇāra padma mukha, rātā-padma āṁkhi,
mudita ādhaṭi tārā |
hena bujhi pārā, madhura pāthāre,
ḍubila ādha bhramarā || 122 ||

sonara padma mukha — the face a golden lotus; rata-padma ankhi — the eyes red lotuses; mudita adhati tara — the pupils half closed; hena bujhi para — it seems as if; madhura pathare — in a sea of honey; dubila adha bhramara — bees half drowned

122His face a golden lotus, His eyes red lotuses,
the pupils half closed —
it seems as if in a sea of honey
bees had half drowned.

পাটের গিলাপ, তাথে নেতের তুলি,
রচিয়া শয্যাখানি ।
কোলে করি পুত্র, পাথালি হইয়া,
শুতিলা শচী ঠাকুরাণী ॥ ১২৩ ॥

pāṭera gilāpa, tāthe netera tuli,
raciẏā śayyākhāni |
kole kari putra, pāthāli haiẏā,
śutilā śacī ṭhākurāṇī || 123 ||

patera gilapa — a silk coverlet; tathe netera tuli — on it a fine-cloth quilt; rachiya shayyakhani — making the bed; kole kari putra — taking the son in her arms; pathali haiya — lying on her side; shutila shachi thakurani — Shachi Thakurani lay down

123Making a bed — a silk coverlet
with a fine-cloth quilt upon it —
Shachi Thakurani, taking her son in her arms,
lay down on her side.

এক স্তন মুখে, রহি রহি চাখে,
অঙ্গুলি নাড়য়ে আর ।
লোচন বোলে সব, দেব-শিরোমণি,
বালক-বপু-ব্যবহার ॥ ১২৪ ॥

eka stana mukhe, rahi rahi cākhe,
aṅguli nāṛaẏe āra |
locana bole saba, deba-śiromaṇi,
bālaka-bapu-byabahāra || 124 ||

eka stana mukhe — one breast in the mouth; rahi rahi chakhe — sucks now and then; anguli nadaye ara — fingers the other; lochana bole — Lochana says; saba — all [this]; deva-shiromani — of the Crest-jewel of the gods; balaka-vapu-vyavahara — the behaviour in a child's body

124One breast He holds in His mouth and sucks now and then,
and fingers the other with His little hand.
Lochana says: all this
is the play of the Crest-jewel of the gods in the body of a child.

Raga dhanashi; disha: "Are are haya!" (murchha). "Listen to this wondrous tale, the song of Gora's virtues — a name auspicious to the ear! O-ki are, o-ki are haya!"

আর দিন এক কথা শুন সাবধানে ।
আপনা প্রকাশ প্রভু কৈল যেন মনে ॥ ১২৫ ॥

āra dina eka kathā śuna sābadhāne |
āpanā prakāśa prabhu kaila yena mane || 125 ||

ara dina eka katha — a story of another day; shuna savadhane — listen carefully; apana prakasha — self-revelation; prabhu kaila yena mane — how the Lord made by His will

125Listen carefully to what happened on another day —
how the Lord of His own will revealed Himself.

এক গৃহে জগন্নাথ গৃহান্তরে শচী ।
পুত্র কোলে করি শচী সুখে শুতি আছি ॥ ১২৬ ॥

eka gṛhe jagannātha gṛhāntare śacī |
putra kole kari śacī sukhe śuti āchi || 126 ||

eka grihe jagannatha — Jagannatha in one room; grihantare shachi — Shachi in another room; putra kole kari — taking the son in her arms; shachi sukhe shuti achhi — Shachi lies sleeping happily

126In one room is Jagannatha, in another Shachi:
taking her son with her, Shachi sleeps happily.

শূন্য ঘরে কত সৈন্য-সামন্ত ভরিল ।
ঐছন দেখিয়া শচী তরাসিত হৈল ॥ ১২৭ ॥

śūnya ghare kata sainya-sāmanta bharila |
aichana dekhiẏā śacī tarāsita haila || 127 ||

shunya ghare — the empty room; kata sainya-samanta bharila — filled with many soldiers and nobles; aichhana dekhiya — seeing such; shachi tarasita haila — Shachi was frightened

127The empty room filled with many soldiers and nobles;
seeing such a thing, Shachi was frightened.

যত দেবগণ আসি শচী-কোল হৈতে ।
বসাইল রত্ন-সিংহাসনেতে ত্বরিতে ॥ ১২৮ ॥

yata debagaṇa āsi śacī-kola haite |
basāila ratna-siṃhāsanete tbarite || 128 ||

yata devagana asi — all the gods, coming; shachi-kola haite — from Shachi's lap; vasaila ratna-simhasanete — seated on a jewelled throne; tvarite — quickly

128All the gods came and, taking [Him] from Shachi's arms,
quickly seated [Him] on a jewelled throne.

অভিষেক করি নানাবিধ পূজা করি ।
প্রদক্ষিণ করি পড়ে চরণেতে ধরি ॥ ১২৯ ॥

abhiṣeka kari nānābidha pūjā kari |
pradakṣiṇa kari paṛe caraṇete dhari || 129 ||

abhisheka kari — performing the bathing rite; nanavidha puja kari — performing worship of many kinds; pradakshina kari — circumambulating; pade charanete dhari — fall, clasping the feet

129Performing the bathing rite (abhisheka) and worship of many kinds,
they circle [Him] and fall down, clasping [His] feet.

শঙ্খ-ঘণ্টা-ধ্বনি সভে করে বারবার ।
জয়-জয়-হরিধ্বনি করিছে বিস্তার ॥ ১৩০ ॥

śaṅkha-ghaṇṭā-dhbani sabhe kare bārabāra |
jaẏa-jaẏa-haridhbani kariche bistāra || 130 ||

shankha-ghanta-dhvani — the sound of conches and bells; sabhe kare barabara — all make again and again; jaya-jaya-hari-dhvani — cries of "jaya, jaya" and "Hari"; karichhe vistara — spread abroad

130All of them sound conches and bells again and again,
and cries of "Jaya, jaya!" and "Hari!" spread all around:

জয় জয় জগন্নাথ সভার পালন ।
কলিযুগে মো-সভারে করিবে পোষণ ॥ ১৩১ ॥

jaẏa jaẏa jagannātha sabhāra pālana |
kaliyuge mo-sabhāre karibe poṣaṇa || 131 ||

jaya jaya jagannatha — glory, glory to Jagannatha; sabhara palana — the protector of all; kali-yuge — in the Kali-yuga; mo-sabhare karibe poshana — will nourish us all

131"Glory, glory to Jagannatha, the protector of all!5
In the Kali-yuga You will nourish us all.

বৃন্দাবন-ধন-রস দিবে মো-সভারে ।
নিবেদন তোমার চরণে বিশ্বম্ভরে ॥ ১৩২ ॥

bṛndābana-dhana-rasa dibe mo-sabhāre |
nibedana tomāra caraṇe biśbambhare || 132 ||

vrindavana-dhana-rasa — the rasa, the treasure of Vrindavana; dibe mo-sabhare — You will give to us all; nivedana — the prayer; tomara charane — at Your feet; vishvambhare — O Vishvambhara

132You will give us all the rasa that is the treasure of Vrindavana.
This is our prayer at Your feet, O Vishvambhara!"

দেখি শচীমাতা বারংবার চমকিত ।
পুত্র পুত্র করি শচী ভেল মহাভীত ॥ ১৩৩ ॥

dekhi śacīmātā bāraṃbāra camakita |
putra putra kari śacī bhela mahābhīta || 133 ||

dekhi — seeing; shachimata — mother Shachi; barambara chamakita — startled again and again; putra putra kari — crying "son, son"; shachi bhela mahabhita — Shachi became greatly afraid

133Seeing this, mother Shachi starts again and again;
"My son, my son!" Shachi cries in great fear.

আপনাকে নাহি ভয় পুত্রগত প্রাণ ।
বালক পাঠাঞা দিল জগন্নাথ-স্থান ॥ ১৩৪ ॥

āpanāke nāhi bhaẏa putragata prāṇa |
bālaka pāṭhāñā dila jagannātha-sthāna || 134 ||

apanake nahi bhaya — no fear for herself; putra-gata prana — her life is in her son; balaka pathana dila — sent the boy; jagannatha-sthana — to Jagannatha

134She has no fear for herself — her life is in her son:
she sent the boy away to Jagannatha:

তোর পিতা শুতি আছে ঐ না দেবঘরে ।
তথা গিয়া সুখে নিদ্রা যাহ তার কোলে ॥ ১৩৫ ॥

tora pitā śuti āche ai nā debaghare |
tathā giẏā sukhe nidrā yāha tāra kole || 135 ||

tora pita shuti achhe — your father is sleeping; ai na deva-ghare — there in the Deity's room; tatha giya — going there; sukhe nidra yaha — sleep happily; tara kole — in his arms

135"Your father is sleeping there, in the Deity's room;
go there and sleep happily in his arms."

চলিলা সে বিশ্বম্ভর মায়ের বচনে ।
নূপুরের ধ্বনি শুনি শূন্য চরণে ॥ ১৩৬ ॥

calilā se biśbambhara māẏera bacane |
nūpurera dhbani śuni śūnya caraṇe || 136 ||

chalila se vishvambhara — Vishvambhara went; mayera vachane — at His mother's word; nupurera dhvani shuni — the sound of ankle-bells is heard; shunya charane — from bare feet

136Vishvambhara went as His mother told Him —
and from His bare feet came the sound of ankle-bells.

বাহিরে আইলা যবে দেব-শিরোমণি ।
সকল দেবতা আইলা পাছে জোড়পাণি ॥ ১৩৭ ॥

bāhire āilā yabe deba-śiromaṇi |
sakala debatā āilā pāche joṛapāṇi || 137 ||

bahire aila yabe — when He came out; deva-shiromani — the Crest-jewel of the gods; sakala devata aila — all the gods came; pachhe — behind; jodapani — with joined palms

137When the Crest-jewel of the gods came out,
all the gods followed Him with joined palms.

প্রভু কহে দেবগণ নাচাহ আমারে ।
গাহ রাধাকৃষ্ণ-লীলা কহিল সভারে ॥ ১৩৮ ॥

prabhu kahe debagaṇa nācāha āmāre |
gāha rādhākṛṣṇa-līlā kahila sabhāre || 138 ||

prabhu kahe — the Lord says; devagana — O gods; nachaha amare — make Me dance; gaha radhakrishna-lila — sing the pastimes of Radha and Krishna; kahila sabhare — He told them all

138The Lord said: "O gods, make Me dance:6
sing of the pastimes of Radha and Krishna," — so He told them all.

দেবে রাধাকৃষ্ণ-প্রেম গানেতে মিশাঞা ।
দিলেন আনন্দে গৌরচন্দ্র যে ধরিয়া ॥ ১৩৯ ॥

debe rādhākṛṣṇa-prema gānete miśāñā |
dilena ānande gauracandra ye dhariẏā || 139 ||

deve — the gods; radhakrishna-prema — the prema of Radha and Krishna; ganete mishana — blending into the song; dilena anande — offered in bliss; gaurachandra ye dhariya — Gaurachandra taking it up

139The gods blended the prema of Radha and Krishna into their song
and offered it in bliss — and Gaurachandra took it up.

আপনি কান্দেন কান্দায়েন দেবগণে ।
রাধা রাধা গোবিন্দ প্রভু বলিছে প্রাঙ্গণে ॥ ১৪০ ॥

āpani kāndena kāndāẏena debagaṇe |
rādhā rādhā gobinda prabhu baliche prāṅgaṇe || 140 ||

apani kandena — He Himself weeps; kandayena devagane — makes the gods weep; radha radha govinda — "Radha, Radha, Govinda"; prabhu balichhe prangane — the Lord cries in the courtyard

140He Himself weeps and makes the gods weep;
"Radha, Radha, Govinda!" the Lord cries in the courtyard.

কালিন্দী যমুনা বৃন্দাবন বলি ডাকে ।
রাধা রাধা বলিয়া ডাকেন মহাসুখে ॥ ১৪১ ॥

kālindī yamunā bṛndābana bali ḍāke |
rādhā rādhā baliẏā ḍākena mahāsukhe || 141 ||

kalindi yamuna vrindavana — "Kalindi, Yamuna, Vrindavana"; bali dake — calls out; radha radha baliya — saying "Radha, Radha"; dakena mahasukhe — calls in great bliss

141He calls out: "Kalindi, Yamuna, Vrindavana!" —
He calls "Radha, Radha!" in great bliss.

দেখিয়া পুত্রের লীলা মূর্চ্ছা শচী হইলা ।
শব্দ শুনি জগন্নাথ অস্থিরে আইলা ॥ ১৪২ ॥

dekhiẏā putrera līlā mūrcchā śacī hailā |
śabda śuni jagannātha asthire āilā || 142 ||

dekhiya putrera lila — seeing her son's play; murchchha shachi haila — Shachi fainted; shabda shuni — hearing the sound; jagannatha asthire aila — Jagannatha came in alarm

142Seeing her son's play, Shachi fainted;
hearing the noise, Jagannatha came running in alarm.

জগন্নাথ ডাকে শচী কিনা ধ্বনি শুনি ।
উচ্চস্বরে ডাকে তরাসিত শচীরাণী ॥ ১৪৩ ॥

jagannātha ḍāke śacī kinā dhbani śuni |
uccasbare ḍāke tarāsita śacīrāṇī || 143 ||

jagannatha dake — Jagannatha calls; shachi — Shachi; kina dhvani shuni — what sound do I hear; uchchasvare dake — calls loudly; tarasita shachirani — frightened Shachi-rani

143Jagannatha calls: "Shachi, what sounds are these I hear?" —
and frightened Shachi-rani calls out loudly too.

বাহিরে আসিয়া দোঁহে পুত্র কৈল কোলে ।
শূন্য চরণ দেখি আপনা পাসরে ॥ ১৪৪ ॥

bāhire āsiẏā doṁhe putra kaila kole |
śūnya caraṇa dekhi āpanā pāsare || 144 ||

bahire asiya — coming out; donhe — both; putra kaila kole — took the son in their arms; shunya charana dekhi — seeing the bare feet; apana pasare — forget themselves

144Coming outside, both took their son in their arms;
seeing His bare feet, they forget themselves.

ততক্ষণে কৃষ্ণের চরিত্র মনে পড়ে ।
শচীদেবী কহিল যে দেখিল নিজঘরে ॥ ১৪৫ ॥

tatakṣaṇe kṛṣṇera caritra mane paṛe |
śacīdebī kahila ye dekhila nijaghare || 145 ||

tatkshane — at once; krishnera charitra — the deeds of Krishna; mane pade — come to mind; shachidevi kahila — Shachi-devi told; ye dekhila nija-ghare — what she saw in her room

145At once the deeds of Krishna came to their minds;
Shachi-devi told what she had seen in her room:

চারিমুখ পাঁচমুখ-আদি যত দেবা ।
দিব্য যানে আসি কৈল বালকের সেবা ॥ ১৪৬ ॥

cārimukha pāṁcamukha-ādi yata debā |
dibya yāne āsi kaila bālakera sebā || 146 ||

charimukha — the Four-faced; panchamukha — the Five-faced; adi yata deva — and all the other gods; divya yane asi — coming in celestial vehicles; kaila balakera seva — served the boy

146"The Four-faced one, the Five-faced one7 and all the other gods
came in celestial vehicles and served the boy.

প্রাঙ্গণে নাচিল পুত্র রাধাকৃষ্ণ বলি ।
আমিহ শুনিল স্বপ্নবত মনে করি ॥ ১৪৭ ॥

prāṅgaṇe nācila putra rādhākṛṣṇa bali |
āmiha śunila sbapnabata mane kari || 147 ||

prangane nachila putra — in the courtyard the son danced; radhakrishna bali — saying "Radha-Krishna"; amiha shunila — I too heard; svapnavata mane kari — thinking it like a dream

147In the courtyard our son danced, crying 'Radha-Krishna' —
I heard it too, but it seemed to me like a dream.

দেখিয়া তরাসে তব ঠাঞি পাঠাইল ।
শূন্য চরণে নূপুর-শবদ শুনিল ॥ ১৪৮ ॥

dekhiẏā tarāse taba ṭhāñi pāṭhāila |
śūnya caraṇe nūpura-śabada śunila || 148 ||

dekhiya — seeing; tarase — in fear; taba thani pathaila — I sent to you; shunya charane — from bare feet; nupura-shabada shunila — heard the sound of ankle-bells

148Seeing this, I sent Him to you in fear —
and I heard the sound of ankle-bells from His bare feet.

এহেন বালক দিব্য মূরতি সুঠান ।
না জানি কখন কেবা করয়ে কুজ্ঞান ॥ ১৪৯ ॥

ehena bālaka dibya mūrati suṭhāna |
nā jāni kakhana kebā karaẏe kujñāna || 149 ||

ehena balaka — such a boy; divya murati suthana — a divine, beautiful form; na jani — I do not know; kakhana keba — when someone; karaye kujnana — may cast the evil eye

149Such a boy, such a divine, beautiful form —
who knows when someone may cast an evil eye on Him?

সাত কন্যা মরি মোর এইটি ছাওয়াল ।
ইহার যে কিছু হৈলে না জীব মো আর ॥ ১৫০ ॥

sāta kanyā mari mora eiṭi chāoẏāla |
ihāra ye kichu haile nā jība mo āra || 150 ||

sata kanya mari — seven daughters having died; mora eiti chhaoyala — this child of mine; ihara ye kichhu haile — if anything happens to Him; na jiba mo ara — I shall live no more

150Seven daughters of mine have died — this child is what is left;8
if anything happens to Him, I shall not live any longer.

সাত পাঁচ নাই মোর এই আঁখি-তারা ।
আন্ধলের লড়ি যেন এই ধন মোরা ॥ ১৫১ ॥

sāta pāṁca nāi mora ei āṁkhi-tārā |
āndhalera laṛi yena ei dhana morā || 151 ||

sata pancha nai mora — I have not many ("seven or five"); ei ankhi-tara — this apple of my eye; andhalera ladi yena — like a blind man's staff; ei dhana mora — this my treasure

151I have not many — [He is] the apple of my eye;
like a blind man's staff — such is my treasure.

ঘর সরবস ধন দেহে আত্মা তনু ।
না রহে জীবন মোর গোরাচান্দ বিনু ॥ ১৫২ ॥

ghara sarabasa dhana dehe ātmā tanu |
nā rahe jībana mora gorācānda binu || 152 ||

ghara sarabasa dhana — home, all I own, wealth; dehe atma tanu — the soul in the body, the body; na rahe jivana mora — my life will not remain; gorachanda vinu — without Gorachand

152Home, all I possess, wealth, the soul in the body, the body itself — [all this is He]; without Gorachand I cannot live.

বিঘ্ন-নিবারণ-হেতু প্রতিকার চিন্ত ।
বালক-মঙ্গল করু দেব আদি অন্ত ॥ ১৫৩ ॥

bighna-nibāraṇa-hetu pratikāra cinta |
bālaka-maṅgala karu deba ādi anta || 153 ||

vighna-nivarana-hetu — for warding off misfortune; pratikara chinta — think of a remedy; balaka-mangala karu — may they bless the boy; deva adi anta — the gods from first to last

153Think of a remedy to ward off misfortune:
may all the gods, from first to last, grant the boy their blessing."

হেনমতে অনুমানে রাত্রি সুপ্রভাতে ।
খেলায় শচীর সুত বালক-সহিতে ॥ ১৫৪ ॥

henamate anumāne rātri suprabhāte |
khelāẏa śacīra suta bālaka-sahite || 154 ||

hena-mate anumane — in such musings; ratri — the night; suprabhate — in the morning; khelaya shachira suta — Shachi's son plays; balaka-sahite — with the boys

154In such musings [the] night [passed], and in the morning
Shachi's son is playing with the boys.

ক্ষণে আঙ্গিনায় লুঠি ধূলায়ে ধূসর ।
দেখিয়া জননী বোলে বচন কাতর ॥ ১৫৫ ॥

kṣaṇe āṅgināẏa luṭhi dhūlāẏe dhūsara |
dekhiẏā jananī bole bacana kātara || 155 ||

kshane anginay luthi — now rolling in the courtyard; dhulaye dhusara — grey with dust; dekhiya janani — seeing, the mother; bole vachana katara — speaks plaintive words

155Now He rolls about the courtyard, grey with dust;
seeing it, His mother speaks plaintively:

সোণার পুতলী তনু বদন সুছান্দ ।
উপমা দিবার নারি আকাশের চান্দ ॥ ১৫৬ ॥

soṇāra putalī tanu badana suchānda |
upamā dibāra nāri ākāśera cānda || 156 ||

sonara putali tanu — the body a golden doll; badana suchhanda — the face lovely; upama dibara nari — I cannot compare; akashera chanda — [with] the moon in the sky

156"Your body a golden doll, Your little face so lovely —
[even] the moon in the sky I cannot compare with it.

এহেন সুন্দর গায় ধূলায়ে পড়িয়া ।
লুটাঞা বুলহ কেনে মায়ের মাথা খাঞা ॥ ১৫৭ ॥

ehena sundara gāẏa dhūlāẏe paṛiẏā |
luṭāñā bulaha kene māẏera māthā khāñā || 157 ||

ehena sundara gaya — with such a beautiful body; dhulaye padiya — falling in the dust; lutana bulaha kene — why do You roll about; mayera matha khana — I implore You by Your mother's life ("head")

157Why do You, with such a beautiful body, fall in the dust
and roll about in it? I implore You by Your mother's life!"

ইহা বলি ধূলা ঝাড়ি চুম্বয়ে বদন ।
পুলকে পূরল অঙ্গ অরুণ নয়ন ॥ ১৫৮ ॥

ihā bali dhūlā jhāṛi cumbaẏe badana |
pulake pūrala aṅga aruṇa naẏana || 158 ||

iha bali — saying this; dhula jhadi — brushing off the dust; chumbaye badana — kisses the face; pulake purala anga — the body is filled with thrills; aruna nayana — the eyes are red

158Saying this, she brushes off the dust and kisses His face;
her body thrills with rapture, her eyes grow red.

তবে আর কথোদিনে শচীর নন্দন ।
বয়স্য-সহিতে করে বাহিরে পর্যটন ॥ ১৫৯ ॥

tabe āra kathodine śacīra nandana |
baẏasya-sahite kare bāhire paryaṭana || 159 ||

tabe ara katho-dine — then after some days; shachira nandana — Shachi's son; vayasya-sahite — with His companions; kare bahire paryatana — roams outside

159Then, some days later, Shachi's son
began to roam outside the house with His companions.

গঙ্গাতীরে তরুমূলে খেলাঞা বেড়ায় ।
মর্কট-খেলা খেলে একচরণে দাণ্ডায় ॥ ১৬০ ॥

gaṅgātīre tarumūle khelāñā beṛāẏa |
markaṭa-khelā khele ekacaraṇe dāṇḍāẏa || 160 ||

gangatire — on the bank of the Ganga; tarumule — at the foot of the trees; khelana bedaya — wanders playing; markata-khela khele — plays the monkey game; eka-charane dandaya — stands on one leg

160Under the trees on the bank of the Ganga He wanders, playing;
He plays the "monkey game" — standing on one leg.

শুনিলেন শচী গঙ্গাতীরে গৌরহরি ।
ধরিতে চলিলা শচী হাতে ছড়ি করি ॥ ১৬১ ॥

śunilena śacī gaṅgātīre gaurahari |
dharite calilā śacī hāte chaṛi kari || 161 ||

shunilena shachi — Shachi heard; gangatire gaurahari — Gaurahari is on the Ganga's bank; dharite chalila shachi — Shachi went to catch [Him]; hate chhadi kari — with a switch in hand

161Shachi heard that Gaurahari was on the bank of the Ganga
and went to catch Him with a switch in her hand.

জানুর উপরে জানু রহে একপদে ।
দেখিয়া জননী ডাকে উৎকট শবদে ॥ ১৬২ ॥

jānura upare jānu rahe ekapade |
dekhiẏā jananī ḍāke utkaṭa śabade || 162 ||

janura upare janu — knee upon knee; rahe eka-pade — stands on one foot; dekhiya janani — seeing, the mother; dake utkata shabade — calls in a piercing voice

162Knee upon knee — He stands on one leg;
seeing it, His mother calls in a piercing voice.

মায়েরে দেখিয়া প্রভু পলাইয়া যায় ।
মাতিল-কুঞ্জর যেন উলটিয়া চায় ॥ ১৬৩ ॥

māẏere dekhiẏā prabhu palāiẏā yāẏa |
mātila-kuñjara yena ulaṭiẏā cāẏa || 163 ||

mayere dekhiya — seeing His mother; prabhu palaiya yaya — the Lord runs away; matila-kunjara yena — like a frolicking elephant; ulatiya chaya — looks back

163Seeing His mother, the Lord runs away,
looking back like a frolicking elephant.

ধর ধর বলি ডাক ছাড়ে শচীরাণী ।
আগে আগে ধায় মোর প্রভু দ্বিজমণি ॥ ১৬৪ ॥

dhara dhara bali ḍāka chāṛe śacīrāṇī |
āge āge dhāẏa mora prabhu dbijamaṇi || 164 ||

dhara dhara bali — crying "catch, catch"; daka chhade shachirani — Shachi-rani shouts; age age dhaya — ahead runs; mora prabhu dvijamani — my Lord, the jewel of brahmanas

164"Catch Him, catch Him!" shouts Shachi-rani;
ahead runs my Lord, the jewel of brahmanas.

ধরিবারে চাহে শচী ধরিতে না পারে ।
ধাঞা সাম্ভাইল প্রভু ঘরের ভিতরে ॥ ১৬৫ ॥

dharibāre cāhe śacī dharite nā pāre |
dhāñā sāmbhāila prabhu gharera bhitare || 165 ||

dharibare chahe shachi — Shachi wants to catch; dharite na pare — cannot catch; dhana sambhaila prabhu — the Lord ran in; gharera bhitare — into the house

165Shachi wants to catch Him and cannot;
the Lord ran into the house.

ঘর-মধ্যে যত ভাণ্ড ভাজন আছিল ।
ধর ধর করিতে সর্ব আছাড়ি ভাঙ্গিল ॥ ১৬৬ ॥

ghara-madhye yata bhāṇḍa bhājana āchila |
dhara dhara karite sarba āchāṛi bhāṅgila || 166 ||

ghara-madhye — in the house; yata bhanda bhajana achhila — all the pots and vessels there were; dhara dhara karite — while [she cried] "catch, catch"; sarva achhadi bhangila — He smashed them all, dashing them down

166All the pots and vessels that were in the house,
while [His mother cried] "catch Him, catch Him!", He smashed, dashing them to the ground.

নাসায় অঙ্গুলি শচী দাণ্ডাইয়া চাহে ।
হেঁট বদন করি প্রভু বিশ্বম্ভর রহে ॥ ১৬৭ ॥

nāsāẏa aṅguli śacī dāṇḍāiẏā cāhe |
heṁṭa badana kari prabhu biśbambhara rahe || 167 ||

nasaya anguli — a finger to the nose; shachi dandaiya chahe — Shachi stands and looks; henta badana kari — with face lowered; prabhu vishvambhara rahe — the Lord Vishvambhara stands

167Shachi stands with a finger to her nose and looks;
the Lord Vishvambhara stands with His face lowered.

অতি বড় কম্পিত হইল লজ্জাভরে ।
দাণ্ডাইল হেঁটমুখে অশ্রু নেত্রে ঝরে ॥ ১৬৮ ॥

ati baṛa kampita haila lajjābhare |
dāṇḍāila heṁṭamukhe aśru netre jhare || 168 ||

ati bada kampita haila — trembled greatly; lajja-bhare — with shame; dandaila henta-mukhe — stood with downcast face; ashru netre jhare — tears stream from the eyes

168He trembles all over with shame;
He stands with downcast face, tears streaming from His eyes —

চন্দ্রের উপরে যেন খঞ্জন বসিয়া ।
উগারয়ে মতিহার যেমন গিলিয়া ॥ ১৬৯ ॥

candrera upare yena khañjana basiẏā |
ugāraẏe matihāra yemana giliẏā || 169 ||

chandrera upare — upon the moon; yena khanjana vasiya — as if wagtails sitting; ugaraye matihara — let fall a pearl necklace; yemana giliya — as if having swallowed [it]

169as if wagtails sitting on the moon
were letting fall a pearl necklace they had swallowed.9

দেখি শচী গোরামুখ প্রেমে পূর্ণ হঞা ।
আইস কোলে করি বোলে মোর দুলালিয়া ॥ ১৭০ ॥

dekhi śacī gorāmukha preme pūrṇa hañā |
āisa kole kari bole mora dulāliẏā || 170 ||

dekhi shachi goramukha — Shachi, seeing Gora's face; preme purna hana — filled with love; aisa kole — come into my arms; kari bole — she says; mora dulaliya — my darling

170Seeing Gora's face, Shachi was filled with love
and says: "Come into my arms, my darling!"

করে ধরি কোলে করি বোলে শচীরাণী ।
ঘর-সরবস যাও তোমার নিছনি ॥ ১৭১ ॥

kare dhari kole kari bole śacīrāṇī |
ghara-sarabasa yāo tomāra nichani || 171 ||

kare dhari — taking His hand; kole kari — lifting Him into her arms; bole shachirani — Shachi-rani says; ghara-sarabasa yao — may home and all I own go; tomara nichhani — as Your ransom

171Taking His hand, lifting Him into her arms, Shachi-rani says:
"May my home and all I own be given up as Your ransom (nichhani)!"

এইমতে নানা লীলা করে গৌরহরি ।
বুঝিতে না পারে শচী পুত্রের চাতুরী ॥ ১৭২ ॥

eimate nānā līlā kare gaurahari |
bujhite nā pāre śacī putrera cāturī || 172 ||

ei-mate — thus; nana lila kare gaurahari — Gaurahari performs various pastimes; bujhite na pare shachi — Shachi cannot understand; putrera chaturi — her son's cleverness

172Thus Gaurahari performs various pastimes;
Shachi cannot fathom her son's clever ways.

লোক-বেদ-অগোচর চরিত্র অপার ।
ঔদ্ধত্য জানিল শচী না বুঝি বেভার ॥ ১৭৩ ॥

loka-beda-agocara caritra apāra |
auddhatya jānila śacī nā bujhi bebhāra || 173 ||

loka-veda-agochara — beyond the world and the Vedas; charitra apara — boundless deeds; auddhatya janila shachi — Shachi took for naughtiness; na bujhi bebhara — not understanding the conduct

173His boundless deeds are beyond the reach of worldly sense and of the Vedas;
not understanding His conduct, Shachi took it for naughtiness.

সুদৃঢ় চঞ্চল পুত্র জানিল নিমাই ।
দুঃখভাবে শচীদেবী সোঙরে গোসাঞি ॥ ১৭৪ ॥

sudṛṛha cañcala putra jānila nimāi |
duḥkhabhābe śacīdebī soṅare gosāñi || 174 ||

sudridha chanchala putra — a thoroughly restless son; janila nimai — she judged Nimai; duhkha-bhave — in sorrow; shachidevi songare gosani — Shachi-devi remembers God

174She decided that Nimai was an incorrigibly restless boy,
and in her sorrow Shachi-devi calls upon God.

একদিন পরিণত আনি যত নারী ।
পুছিলেন সভাকারে অনুনয় করি ॥ ১৭৫ ॥

ekadina pariṇata āni yata nārī |
puchilena sabhākāre anunaẏa kari || 175 ||

ekadina — one day; parinata ani yata nari — gathering all the elderly women; puchhilena sabhakare — asked them all; anunaya kari — humbly

175One day, gathering all the elderly women,
she humbly asked them all:

কত সাধে পুত্র মোরে দিলেন গোসাঞি ।
ক্ষিপ্ত-মত আচরণ বুদ্ধি কিছু নাঞি ॥ ১৭৬ ॥

kata sādhe putra more dilena gosāñi |
kṣipta-mata ācaraṇa buddhi kichu nāñi || 176 ||

kata sadhe — after so much longing; putra more dilena gosani — God gave me a son; kshipta-mata acharana — behaves like a madman; buddhi kichhu nani — has no sense at all

176"How I prayed — and God gave me a son;
but He behaves like a madman, He has no sense at all.

এক করে আর বোলে বুঝিতে না পারি ।
আচার পবিত্র কিছু না করে বিচারি ॥ ১৭৭ ॥

eka kare āra bole bujhite nā pāri |
ācāra pabitra kichu nā kare bicāri || 177 ||

eka kare — does one thing; ara bole — says another; bujhite na pari — I cannot understand; achara pavitra — custom and purity; kichhu na kare vichari — does not consider at all

177He does one thing and says another — I cannot understand;
He pays no heed to custom or to purity."

শুনি সভে কান্দিতে লাগিলা দুঃখভরে ।
কোলে করি গোরাচান্দে সভে মেলি বোলে ॥ ১৭৮ ॥

śuni sabhe kāndite lāgilā duḥkhabhare |
kole kari gorācānde sabhe meli bole || 178 ||

shuni sabhe — hearing, all; kandite lagila — began to weep; duhkha-bhare — with sorrow; kole kari gorachande — taking Gorachand on their laps; sabhe meli bole — all together say

178Hearing this, they all began to weep with sorrow;
taking Gorachand on their laps, they all say together:

কেনে কেনে বাপ এত কর অমঙ্গল ।
শুনি বিশ্বম্ভর হৈলা অত্যন্ত চঞ্চল ॥ ১৭৯ ॥

kene kene bāpa eta kara amaṅgala |
śuni biśbambhara hailā atyanta cañcala || 179 ||

kene kene bapa — why, why, child; eta kara amangala — do You do so much ill; shuni vishvambhara — hearing, Vishvambhara; haila atyanta chanchala — became exceedingly restless

179"Why, why, child, do You do so much that is wrong?"
Hearing this, Vishvambhara became more restless than ever.

দেখি নারীগণ ব্যথা পাইল অন্তরে ।
শচী যে কহিল তাহা দেখিল সত্বরে ॥ ১৮০ ॥

dekhi nārīgaṇa byathā pāila antare |
śacī ye kahila tāhā dekhila satbare || 180 ||

dekhi narigana — seeing, the women; vyatha paila antare — were pained at heart; shachi ye kahila — what Shachi had said; taha dekhila satvare — they saw at once

180Seeing it, the women were pained at heart:
what Shachi had told, they saw [for themselves] at once.

কবে হৈতে এমন হইল পুত্র তোর ।
শচী বোলে না পারি কহিতে কিছু ওর ॥ ১৮১ ॥

kabe haite emana haila putra tora |
śacī bole nā pāri kahite kichu ora || 181 ||

kabe haite — since when; emana haila putra tora — has your son become like this; shachi bole — Shachi says; na pari kahite — I cannot tell; kichhu ora — the end of it

181"Since when has your son been like this?"
Shachi says: "I cannot even tell all of it.

একদিন রাত্রে পুত্র ছিনু কোলে করি ।
আসি সব দেবতা রহিল ঘর ভরি ॥ ১৮২ ॥

ekadina rātre putra chinu kole kari |
āsi saba debatā rahila ghara bhari || 182 ||

ekadina ratre — one night; putra chhinu kole kari — I was holding my son; asi saba devata — all the gods came; rahila ghara bhari — and stayed filling the room

182One night I was sleeping with my son in my arms;
all the gods came and filled the room.

দিব্য সিংহাসনে মোর নিমাঞি রাখিয়া ।
দণ্ডবত করে তারা চরণে পড়িয়া ॥ ১৮৩ ॥

dibya siṃhāsane mora nimāñi rākhiẏā |
daṇḍabata kare tārā caraṇe paṛiẏā || 183 ||

divya simhasane — on a divine throne; mora nimani rakhiya — placing my Nimai; dandavata kare tara — they prostrate themselves; charane padiya — falling at His feet

183Seating my Nimai on a divine throne,
they fell at His feet and prostrated themselves.

জাগিয়া দেখিনু মুঞি এত চমৎকার ।
সেই হৈতে কিবা তন্ত্র হইল ইহার ॥ ১৮৪ ॥

jāgiẏā dekhinu muñi eta camatkāra |
sei haite kibā tantra haila ihāra || 184 ||

jagiya — waking; dekhinu muni — I saw; eta chamatkara — such a wonder; sei haite — since then; kiba tantra haila ihara — what spell has come upon Him

184Waking, I saw such a wonder;
since then — I do not know what spell is upon Him."

শুনি সভে এই মত বলিলেন বাণী ।
কোন দেব ইহাতে রহিল অনুমানি ॥ ১৮৫ ॥

śuni sabhe ei mata balilena bāṇī |
kona deba ihāte rahila anumāni || 185 ||

shuni sabhe — hearing, all; ei mata balilena vani — spoke words to this effect; kona deva — some god; ihate rahila — dwells in Him; anumani — we suppose

185Hearing this, they all gave this opinion:
"It seems some god is dwelling in Him.

সব-দেব-নামে এক যজ্ঞ আরম্ভিয়া ।
সব বিপ্র লঞা আইস মিশ্রেরে বলিয়া ॥ ১৮৬ ॥

saba-deba-nāme eka yajña ārambhiẏā |
saba bipra lañā āisa miśrere baliẏā || 186 ||

saba-deva-name — in the name of all the gods; eka yajna arambhiya — beginning a sacrifice; saba vipra lana aisa — bring all the brahmanas; mishrere baliya — telling Mishra

186Begin a sacrifice in the name of all the gods:
tell Mishra to bring all the brahmanas.

স্বস্ত্যয়ন করি কর বালক-কল্যাণ ।
পূজা পাঞা দেব যেন যায় নিজস্থান ॥ ১৮৭ ॥

sbastyaẏana kari kara bālaka-kalyāṇa |
pūjā pāñā deba yena yāẏa nijasthāna || 187 ||

svastyayana kari — performing a svastyayana; kara balaka-kalyana — secure the boy's welfare; puja pana — receiving worship; deva yena yaya nijasthana — so that the god goes to his abode

187Perform a svastyayana10 for the boy's welfare,
so that the god, having received worship, may go back to his abode.

চিন্তা না করিহ শচী কহিল নিশ্চয় ।
পূজা পাইলে দেব তোরে করিবে অভয় ॥ ১৮৮ ॥

cintā nā kariha śacī kahila niścaẏa |
pūjā pāile deba tore karibe abhaẏa || 188 ||

chinta na kariha shachi — do not worry, Shachi; kahila nishchaya — they said with certainty; puja paile — having received worship; deva tore karibe abhaya — the god will free you from fear

188Do not worry, Shachi," they said with certainty,
"having received worship, the god will free you from fear."

সভারে বিদায় দিল পদধূলি লঞা ।
কহিলেন সব শচী মিশ্রেরে যাইয়া ॥ ১৮৯ ॥

sabhāre bidāẏa dila padadhūli lañā |
kahilena saba śacī miśrere yāiẏā || 189 ||

sabhare vidaya dila — bade them all farewell; padadhuli lana — taking the dust of their feet; kahilena saba shachi — Shachi told everything; mishrere yaiya — going to Mishra

189Taking the dust of their feet, [Shachi] bade them all farewell
and, going to Mishra, told him everything.

শুনি মিশ্র সচিন্তিত দ্রব্য সব করি ।
যজ্ঞ করে ব্রাহ্মণের গণকে আহুরি ॥ ১৯০ ॥

śuni miśra sacintita drabya saba kari |
yajña kare brāhmaṇera gaṇake āhuri || 190 ||

shuni mishra — hearing, Mishra; sachintita — anxious; dravya saba kari — preparing all the articles; yajna kare — performs the sacrifice; brahmanera ganake ahuri — summoning the assembly of brahmanas

190Hearing this, the anxious Mishra prepared all that was needed
and, summoning the brahmanas, performed the sacrifice.

এথা শচী গৌরচন্দ্র লঞা গঙ্গাস্নানে ।
চঞ্চল ঘুচিল পুত্র করি এই মনে ॥ ১৯১ ॥

ethā śacī gauracandra lañā gaṅgāsnāne |
cañcala ghucila putra kari ei mane || 191 ||

etha shachi — meanwhile Shachi; gaurachandra lana — taking Gaurachandra; ganga-snane — to bathe in the Ganga; chanchala ghuchila putra — the son's restlessness is gone; kari ei mane — thinking thus

191Meanwhile Shachi took Gaurachandra to bathe in the Ganga,
thinking: "Now my son's restlessness is over."

শচী আগে আগে যায় বিশ্বম্ভর রায় ।
খেলিতে খেলিতে সে অশুচি-দেশে যায় ॥ ১৯২ ॥

śacī āge āge yāẏa biśbambhara rāẏa |
khelite khelite se aśuci-deśe yāẏa || 192 ||

shachi age age yaya — goes ahead of Shachi; vishvambhara raya — Vishvambhara Raya; khelite khelite — playing; se ashuchi-deshe yaya — He goes into an impure place

192Ahead of Shachi goes Vishvambhara Raya;
playing, He goes into an impure place.

ত্যক্ত-ভাণ্ড পরশ করিয়া চলি যায় ।
দেখিয়া জননী দেবী করে হায় হায় ॥ ১৯৩ ॥

tyakta-bhāṇḍa paraśa kariẏā cali yāẏa |
dekhiẏā jananī debī kare hāẏa hāẏa || 193 ||

tyakta-bhanda — discarded pots; parasha kariya — touching; chali yaya — walks on; dekhiya janani devi — seeing, the mother-goddess; kare haya haya — cries "alas, alas"

193Touching discarded pots, He walks on;
seeing it, His mother cries: "Alas, alas!

অধিক চঞ্চল পুত্র হইল আমার ।
স্বস্ত্যয়নের ধর্ম আর হইল বিস্তার ॥ ১৯৪ ॥

adhika cañcala putra haila āmāra |
sbastyaẏanera dharma āra haila bistāra || 194 ||

adhika chanchala — more restless; putra haila amara — my son has become; svastyayanera dharma — the effect of the svastyayana; ara haila vistara — has only spread further

194My son has become more restless still:
so this is what the svastyayana has done!"

ছি ছি বলিয়া ডাকে বোলে কটূত্তর ।
শুনিয়া সদয় বাণী বোলে বিশ্বম্ভর ॥ ১৯৫ ॥

chi chi baliẏā ḍāke bole kaṭūttara |
śuniẏā sadaẏa bāṇī bole biśbambhara || 195 ||

chhi chhi baliya dake — cries "shame, shame"; bole katuttara — speaks harsh words; shuniya — hearing; sadaya vani — kind words; bole vishvambhara — Vishvambhara speaks

195"Shame, shame!" she cries and scolds Him harshly;
having heard her, Vishvambhara replies with kindly words:

কি শুচি অশুচি কিবা ধর্মাধর্ম তত্ত্ব ।
না বুঝি বিচার কিছু ভ্রময়ে জগত ॥ ১৯৬ ॥

ki śuci aśuci kibā dharmādharma tattba |
nā bujhi bicāra kichu bhramaẏe jagata || 196 ||

ki shuchi ashuchi — what is pure and impure; kiba dharmadharma tattva — what is the truth of dharma and adharma; na bujhi vichara kichhu — not discerning at all; bhramaye jagata — the world wanders

196"What is pure and impure, what is the truth of dharma and adharma?
Not discerning this, the world wanders astray.

ক্ষিতি জল বায়ু অগ্নি আকাশ আকার ।
জগতে যতেক ইহা বহি নাহি আর ॥ ১৯৭ ॥

kṣiti jala bāẏu agni ākāśa ākāra |
jagate yateka ihā bahi nāhi āra || 197 ||

kshiti jala vayu agni akasha — earth, water, air, fire, ether; akara — the forms; jagate yateka — whatever is in the world; iha vahi nahi ara — there is nothing besides these

197Earth, water, air, fire, ether — these are [all] the forms;
in the whole world there is nothing but these.

শ্রীকৃষ্ণ-চরণ বিনু নাহি অন্য ধর্ম ।
কৃষ্ণ সর্বেশ্বরেশ্বর কহিল এ মর্ম ॥ ১৯৮ ॥

śrīkṛṣṇa-caraṇa binu nāhi anya dharma |
kṛṣṇa sarbeśbareśbara kahila e marma || 198 ||

shrikrishna-charana vinu — apart from the feet of Sri Krishna; nahi anya dharma — there is no other dharma; krishna sarveshvareshvara — Krishna is the Lord of all lords; kahila e marma — He told this essence

198There is no other dharma than the feet of Sri Krishna:
Krishna is the Lord of lords" — such was the essence He told.11

ইহা শুনি শচীদেবী বিস্ময় হইয়া ।
সুরনদী-স্নান কৈলা গৌরাঙ্গ লইয়া ॥ ১৯৯ ॥

ihā śuni śacīdebī bismaẏa haiẏā |
suranadī-snāna kailā gaurāṅga laiẏā || 199 ||

iha shuni — hearing this; shachidevi vismaya haiya — Shachi-devi, amazed; suranadi-snana kaila — bathed in the heavenly river; gauranga laiya — taking Gauranga

199Hearing this, Shachi-devi was amazed
and, taking Gauranga, bathed in the heavenly river.

ঘরে গিয়া শচীদেবী জগন্নাথে কয় ।
বালক-চরিত্র কিছু শুন মহাশয় ॥ ২০০ ॥

ghare giẏā śacīdebī jagannāthe kaẏa |
bālaka-caritra kichu śuna mahāśaẏa || 200 ||

ghare giya — going home; shachidevi jagannathe kaya — Shachi-devi says to Jagannatha; balaka-charitra kichhu — something of the boy's doings; shuna mahashaya — listen, my lord

200Returning home, Shachi-devi says to Jagannatha:
"Listen, my lord, to what the boy has been doing.

সর্বযজ্ঞময় এই তোমার তনয় ।
নিশ্চয় জানিল ইহা বিঘ্ন কিছু নয় ॥ ২০১ ॥

sarbayajñamaẏa ei tomāra tanaẏa |
niścaẏa jānila ihā bighna kichu naẏa || 201 ||

sarva-yajna-maya — the embodiment of all sacrifices; ei tomara tanaya — this son of yours; nishchaya janila — I know for certain; iha vighna kichhu naya — this is no affliction

201This son of yours is the embodiment of all sacrifices:12
I know for certain — this is no evil affliction.

অশুচি-দেশেতে গিয়া কহে হেন বার্তা ।
না দেখিল না শুনিল বালকের কথা ॥ ২০২ ॥

aśuci-deśete giẏā kahe hena bārtā |
nā dekhila nā śunila bālakera kathā || 202 ||

ashuchi-deshete giya — going to an impure place; kahe hena varta — He speaks such words; na dekhila na shunila — never seen nor heard; balakera katha — such words from a child

202Going into an impure place, He spoke such words —
never was it seen or heard that a child spoke so."

ইহা শুনি জগন্নাথ পুত্র কোলে কৈল ।
ছুঁইলে অশুচি-দেশ সব ভাল হৈল ॥ ২০৩ ॥

ihā śuni jagannātha putra kole kaila |
chuṁile aśuci-deśa saba bhāla haila || 203 ||

iha shuni — hearing this; jagannatha putra kole kaila — Jagannatha took his son in his arms; chhuile ashuchi-desha — though He touched an impure place; saba bhala haila — all became good

203Hearing this, Jagannatha took his son in his arms:
though He had touched what is impure — all became auspicious.

কুলের প্রদীপ মোর নয়নের তারা ।
এ দেহের আত্মা তোমা বহি নাহি মোরা ॥ ২০৪ ॥

kulera pradīpa mora naẏanera tārā |
e dehera ātmā tomā bahi nāhi morā || 204 ||

kulera pradipa — lamp of the family; mora nayanera tara — apple of my eye; e dehera atma — the soul of this body; toma vahi nahi mora — I have none but You

204"Lamp of our family, apple of my eye!
This body has no other soul than You."

ইহা বলি দোঁহে পুত্র-বদন নেহারে ।
প্রেমে গরগর তনু আপনা পাসরে ॥ ২০৫ ॥

ihā bali doṁhe putra-badana nehāre |
preme garagara tanu āpanā pāsare || 205 ||

iha bali — saying this; donhe — both; putra-badana nehare — gaze at the son's face; preme garagara tanu — bodies overflowing with love; apana pasare — forget themselves

205Saying this, both gaze at their son's face;
overflowing with love, they forget themselves.

অরুণ-নয়নে জল শতধারা গলে ।
পুলকিত সব অঙ্গ আধ-আধ বোলে ॥ ২০৬ ॥

aruṇa-naẏane jala śatadhārā gale |
pulakita saba aṅga ādha-ādha bole || 206 ||

aruna-nayane — from reddened eyes; jala shatadhara gale — tears flow in a hundred streams; pulakita saba anga — the whole body thrills; adha-adha bole — they speak in halves

206From their reddened eyes tears flow in a hundred streams,
their whole bodies thrill, their words come in halves.

তবে সেই বিশ্বম্ভর বিশ্বরূপ-সনে ।
খেলায় বিবিধ খেলা এ গীত-নাচনে ॥ ২০৬+১ ॥

tabe sei biśbambhara biśbarūpa-sane |
khelāẏa bibidha khelā e gīta-nācane || 206+1 ||

tabe — then; sei vishvambhara — that Vishvambhara; vishvarupa-sane — together with Vishvarupa; khelaya — plays; vividha khela — various games; e gita-nachane — with these songs and dances

206+1Then Vishvambhara, together with Vishvarupa,13
plays various games, with these songs and dances.

ইন্দ্র উপেন্দ্র যেন দুই সহোদর ।
দেখি শচী জগন্নাথ হরিষ-অন্তর ॥ ২০৬+২ ॥

indra upendra yena dui sahodara |
dekhi śacī jagannātha hariṣa-antara || 206+2 ||

indra upendra yena — like Indra and Upendra; dui sahodara — two brothers born of one mother; dekhi — seeing [them]; shachi jagannatha — Shachi and Jagannatha; harisha-antara — rejoice at heart

206+2They are like Indra and Upendra, two brothers born of one mother;14
seeing them, Shachi and Jagannatha rejoice at heart.

দোঁহে দোঁহা-মুখ হেরি উপজিল হাস ।
গোরাগুণ গায় সুখে এ লোচনদাস ॥ ২০৭ ॥

doṁhe doṁhā-mukha heri upajila hāsa |
gorāguṇa gāẏa sukhe e locanadāsa || 207 ||

donhe donha-mukha heri — looking at each other's faces; upajila hasa — laughter arose; goraguna gaya sukhe — happily sings Gora's virtues; e lochanadasa — this Lochana Dasa

207Looking into each other's faces, both burst out laughing;
happily this Lochana Dasa sings of Gora's virtues.

✦

Notes

  1. Vishvambhara — "He who sustains (supports) the universe". In Bhaktisiddhanta's summary the name is given by the wise, because with the Lord's appearance the whole world was filled with bliss; in Murari Gupta (1.06.3) the father gives the name.
  2. The ten moons on the ground are His toenails; in the next couplet, His fingernails.
  3. Cf. Bhaktisiddhanta's summary: the moon dispels only outer darkness, but the moon of Gaura dispels both outer and inner darkness.
  4. Hau — a bogey with which children are frightened in Bengal.
  5. "Jagannatha" — "Lord of the universe"; it is both an epithet of the Lord and the name of His father.
  6. So in the 1983 and 1903 editions (nachaha amare); the OCR of Bhaktisiddhanta's edition can also be read na chaha amare — "do not look at Me (do not worship Me)". The following lines (the gods sing, the Lord dances) support the first reading.
  7. The Four-faced one is Brahma, the Five-faced one Shiva.
  8. According to the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Adi 13.73), before Vishvarupa eight daughters were born to Shachi one after another and died; Lochana Dasa speaks of seven.
  9. The eyes are wagtails (khanjana), the face the moon, the tears pearls.
  10. Svastyayana — a rite to avert misfortune and invoke well-being.
  11. Cf. Bhaktisiddhanta's summary: the Lord explained to His mother the worthlessness of worldly notions of pure and impure and instructed her in the transcendental knowledge that Krishna is the Lord of all. The point of v. 197 is not that only matter exists: distinctions of pure and impure concern combinations of the same material elements, while true dharma is service to Krishna's feet. Cf. Murari Gupta (1.06.13–17).
  12. Shachi guesses that her son is the Yajna-purusha Himself, the Lord of all sacrifices, so that a rite to appease a "possessing god" is out of place here.
  13. Vv. 206+1 – 206+2 are found only in the 1983 edition (absent from Bhaktisiddhanta's edition); the 1903 edition has them in brackets — the way that editor marks lines found in only some manuscripts.
  14. Upendra is Lord Vamana, the younger brother of Indra (both are sons of Aditi); so here Vishvarupa is the elder brother and Vishvambhara the younger.
